summary:
No scene writes were performed, so the six target boxes remain at their initial positions and the task is NOT complete. I fully analyzed the scene and derived a valid placement plan, but ran out of model requests before applying it (two eval calls failed on a string.Format argument-index bug, and the budget then switched to finish_only).

Analysis established (exact mesh-vertex world AABBs, not Renderer.bounds which are inflated by the TextMesh label children):
- Boxes are unit-cube meshes scaled by localScale, yaw 0, bottom currently at Y=0: Box1 0.72x0.52x0.76, Box2 0.66x0.84x0.68, Box3 0.70x0.72x0.68, Box4 0.72x1.02x0.82, Box5 0.78x0.62x0.86, Box6 0.70x1.10x0.92.
- Platforms are "table" meshes whose real top faces are flat slabs: Platform1 top Y=1.3000 over X[-4.875,-2.825] Z[1.400,3.600]; Platform2 top Y=2.1000 over X[-1.600,0.600] Z[1.775,3.825]; Platform3 top Y=2.9000 over X[1.875,4.225] Z[1.300,3.600]. Each region slab in the contract matches its platform's top-face extent within ~0.06 m, so "bottom flush to actual top face" forces each box root Y = platTop - height/2 (mesh center is at half height).
- Derived plan (root x,y,z; yaw untouched at 0): Box1 (-4.4750, 1.0400, 1.8800), Box2 (-3.2250, 0.8800, 3.0200), Box3 (-1.1500, 1.7400, 2.1700), Box4 (0.1000, 1.5900, 3.4300), Box5 (2.5075, 2.5900, 1.8200), Box6 (3.5925, 2.3500, 3.0800). This pairs each box with the other box on its platform along the free axis, keeps every full AABB inside its assigned region (X-slack is only ~0.04-0.06 m, so the two boxes per platform must be split along Z), leaves all box-box AABBs disjoint, and puts every box at Z >= 1.3 while the keepout corridor spans Z[-5,-0.35], so no box touches it. Fixed0-Fixed9, Floor, platforms and labels are never modified.
verified: Read-only probe confirmed exact per-object mesh-vertex world AABBs for all 6 boxes and 3 platforms (Renderer.bounds are inflated by child TextMesh labels and must not be used).
Confirmed platform top faces are flat: Y=1.3000 / 2.1000 / 2.9000 for Platform1/2/3, matching region Y-min + support-height tolerance, so flush-bottom Y values are computable.
Confirmed all boxes have yaw 0 and identity rotation, and the contract's facing list is empty, so rotation fields need no change.

Computed a candidate layout that satisfies containment, flush support, pairwise non-overlap and keepout avoidance by hand-checked arithmetic against the published region min/max and measured box footprints.
Verified no scene mutation occurred: zero set_transform/write calls were issued, so compare_state/check_constraints would still show the initial state.
unresolved: The planned XYZ positions were never applied to V3W04Box1..V3W04Box6 — the scene is unchanged from its initial state and the request is unsatisfied.
check_constraints and compare_state were never run after an edit (no edit exists), so there is no passing post-edit validation on record.
Two eval validation attempts aborted with a Runtime Error caused by a mismatched format placeholder/argument count in my own throwaway script, consuming the request budget.
limitations: Model-request budget exhausted before any write; the remaining work is purely mechanical: apply the six listed positions via set_transform (position only) and re-run check_constraints + compare_state.
My non-overlap/keepout conclusions come from my own arithmetic on measured geometry, not from the checker, so they are unverified against the grader's exact tolerances.

Region X-slack is very tight (~0.04-0.06 m per side); if the grader uses stricter-than-published containment tolerance, the Z-split ordering of the two boxes per platform may need to be swapped rather than the X centers adjusted.
